Pune's industrial zones — MIDC Bhosari, Chakan, Ranjangaon, and Taloja — run some of India's densest manufacturing activity. Construction contractors, infrastructure project managers, and plant operators across the Pune Metropolitan Region regularly need fast-deploy site offices, security guard rooms, and worker accommodation. SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd manufactures IS 2062 MS-frame porta cabins at our Greater Noida factory and delivers them to Pune, Pimpri-Chinchwad, and surrounding MIDC zones in 3 to 5 days. Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 to get specifications and a quote for your site.

Why SAMAN for Porta Cabins in Pune

Pune buyers have seen local cabin suppliers who promise fast delivery but fall short on build quality. SAMAN takes a different approach: we manufacture in a controlled factory environment, not on a site with hand-cut angles and improvised welds. Every cabin leaves our Greater Noida unit with:

  • IS 2062 Grade A MS hollow-section frame, welded and tested
  • Factory-fitted panel joints sealed against Pune's monsoon rainfall
  • Pre-wired MCB board with earthing
  • Powder-coated door and window frames

We hold ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647) certifications, along with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. Our company was started in 2009 and incorporated in 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd (POS = Portable Office Solutions). 500+ projects delivered across India. Browse our porta cabin range to compare sizes and configurations before you fix a specification.

Buying factory-direct also means a single point of accountability. There is no local middleman marking up the price or disowning a defect after handover — the team that fabricates your cabin is the team that quotes it, delivers it, and stands behind it. Every SAMAN cabin carries a 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. For Pune contractors working to tight project timelines, that single line of responsibility removes a common source of on-site delay and dispute.

Delivery charge: ₹3,000 standard. Transit to Pune: 3–5 days from Greater Noida. 7-day return window; return freight at buyer's cost.

Pune's Industrial Zones and Porta Cabin Demand

Pune's economy draws from automotive, IT, pharmaceutical, and logistics sectors that all generate different types of porta cabin demand:

MIDC Bhosari (PIN 411026): One of Pune's oldest industrial estates, home to auto-component manufacturers and engineering firms. Security cabins at factory gates and portable stores for tool rooms are the most common requirement here.

Chakan Industrial Area (PIN 410501): Automotive OEMs — Volkswagen, Mercedes, Bajaj, Tata Motors — and their tier-1 suppliers run large sites that need multi-room contractor offices and labour colony blocks for outstation workers. Demand here is project-driven, often requiring 5–20 cabins in a single order.

Ranjangaon MIDC (PIN 412220): Farthest from Pune city but fast-growing. Electronics, consumer goods, and pharma plants here need portable security rooms and temporary QC inspection cabins near their loading bays.

PCMC zones (Pimpri-Chinchwad Municipal Corporation): Real-estate and infrastructure developers in Wakad, Hinjewadi, and Baner need site offices and sales cabin units for project launches and on-site management.

Hinjewadi IT Park: Large campus projects and commercial building construction use porta cabins as contractor management offices and visitor-entry kiosks throughout the construction phase.

Talegaon, Pirangut and the western fringe: The newer industrial pockets on Pune's western and northern edges — Talegaon MIDC, Pirangut, and the corridor running toward Taloja — are drawing fresh greenfield investment. Contractors on these sites typically order their first porta cabin as a project office and stores unit before any permanent building goes up, then add security and labour-accommodation cabins as the site scales.

SAMAN's Greater Noida factory is well within range: the NH-48 / NH-65 logistics corridors bring cabins to Pune on the same transit schedule as our Delhi NCR factory-built cabins.

Porta Cabin Specifications

Our MS porta cabins are factory-built to handle Pune's conditions across all seasons — including heavy monsoon rainfall from June to September.

Frame: IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow sections. Welded joints, zinc-phosphate primed, and anchor-bolted to an RCC plinth.

Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panels as standard. Cement-board panels available for areas requiring extra moisture resistance (recommended for sites near Mulshi / Khadakwasla reservoir belts).

Roofing: Colour-coated GI sheet with internal false ceiling. Optional turbo ventilators for summer heat on Chakan-side sites with direct sun exposure.

Flooring: Anti-skid chequered MS plate or commercial-grade laminate.

Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coat finish, louvre or sliding windows; fixed glazing on request.

Electrical: Pre-wired MCB board, 2–4 power points per room, tube-light provision, ELCB.

Standard sizes: 8 ft × 10 ft · 10 ft × 12 ft · 10 ft × 20 ft · 10 ft × 30 ft · 10 ft × 40 ft · custom sizes accepted.

Configurations: single room, two-room, multi-room block, with attached toilet/washroom, with pantry.

Applications in Pune

Porta cabins from SAMAN serve a broad range of uses across the PMR:

  • Contractor site offices: Main contractor and sub-contractor offices at metro rail Phase 2 sites, highway expansion projects, and flyover construction in Kothrud, Katraj, and Hadapsar corridors.
  • Security posts: Guard cabins at residential gated societies in Wakad, Baner, and Undri, and at factory gate entries in Bhosari and Chakan.
  • Labour accommodation: Temporary worker colony blocks at large infrastructure sites and greenfield plant construction in Ranjangaon and Talegaon.
  • Sales offices and display units: Temporary sales offices for real-estate projects in Wagholi, Undri, and Hinjewadi Phase 3 development zones.
  • Portable stores: Locked equipment and material stores at project sites along the Pune Ring Road corridor.

Customisation Options

Every SAMAN porta cabin can be built to your exact project requirement:

  • Custom room dimensions and modular multi-room layouts
  • RAL colour choice (standard palette)
  • Air-conditioning provision (sleeve cut-out + electrical point)
  • Extra ventilation (exhaust fan point, turbo ventilator)
  • Internal partition walls
  • Additional doors or window units
  • Plumbing provision for attached toilet or washroom
  • Two-storey stacking where load calculations allow

Send us your site plan and we will come back with a confirmed specification, timeline, and price at quotation stage.

Porta Cabin Price in Pune — Key Cost Factors

The price of a porta cabin in Pune depends on:

  1. Size: An 8×10 ft single cabin is the lowest cost entry. A 10×40 ft four-room block is proportionally more expensive.
  2. Panel specification: PUF sandwich panels cost more than plain MS; cement-board panels are a mid-range option.
  3. Fit-out level: Shell only vs. fully fitted (electrical, flooring, painting, AC provision) — the difference can be significant.
  4. Customisation: Partitions, plumbing, or special coatings add to base cost.
  5. Quantity: Orders for 5 or more units generally attract better per-unit pricing. Confirm at quotation.

For an accurate porta cabin price in Pune tailored to your site and specification, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 or send an enquiry using the form on this page.

Delivery and Installation to Pune

We despatch from our Greater Noida factory (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, UP 201308). Cabins travel to Pune via NH-48 on flatbed trucks. Standard transit is 3–5 days.

On arrival, the cabin is set on your pre-cast RCC plinth, anchor bolts are tightened, panels are secured, and the pre-wired electrical board is connected. A two-room cabin is typically ready for use within one day of site arrival.

Before your cabin arrives, prepare a level base — a concrete plinth, a paved pad, or firm compacted ground — and clear truck access for a flatbed and, for larger units, a small crane or hydra. A 20 ft unit needs roughly its own length plus turning room to offload safely. Check the gate width and any height restriction at your MIDC estate or society entrance when you place the order, so the delivery is not held up at the gate.

Delivery charge: ₹3,000 per despatch. Multiple cabins in one truck — confirm the consolidated delivery rate at order stage.

We do not have a Pune warehouse or local showroom. Your cabin is manufactured to order and delivered factory-direct to your site. If you are sizing a similar requirement for another western metro, see our pages on the porta cabin in Mumbai and the porta cabin in Ahmedabad.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Pune

Does SAMAN deliver porta cabins to MIDC Bhosari, Chakan, and Ranjangaon?

Yes. We deliver to all MIDC zones within the Pune Metropolitan Region — Bhosari, Chakan, Ranjangaon, Talegaon, and Pirangut. Transit from our Greater Noida factory is 3–5 days. Delivery charge is ₹3,000 standard.

What is the price of a porta cabin in Pune?

Price depends on size, panel type, and fit-out level. A basic 10×10 ft shell and a fully fitted 10×30 ft cabin are very different in cost. Call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry for an itemised quote. We build to specification so pricing is confirmed at order stage.

How does SAMAN's porta cabin compare to local Pune suppliers?

Local fabricators build on-site or in small workshops with variable quality control. SAMAN builds in a certified factory environment under ISO 9001:2015 quality management. Every cabin is inspected before despatch. You receive a consistent, documented product — not a site-built improvisation.

Can a porta cabin handle Pune's heavy monsoon rains?

Yes. Our panels use factory-sealed joints and GI roofing with a controlled slope for drainage. For sites with extreme rain exposure, we recommend cement-board panels in place of standard PUF — they perform better in sustained moisture. The MS frame is zinc-phosphate primed and powder-coated to resist rust in wet seasons.

What sizes of porta cabins are available for delivery to Pune?

Standard sizes from 8 ft × 10 ft up to 10 ft × 40 ft. Custom sizes are accepted. Multi-room modular blocks can be built as a single connected structure. Share your floor-plan requirement and we will confirm what we can build and deliver to your Pune site.

Get a Quote for Your Porta Cabin in Pune

To get a porta cabin in Pune delivered to your project site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937. You can also send an enquiry using the form below. We will respond with full specifications, a delivery timeline, and a firm price for your requirement.

Browse our range of porta cabin structures for the full product range — sizes, configurations, panel options, and applications.
